verdict.rationale: Shortcut ships workflow automations: auto-start and auto-complete Epics, and auto-create Iterations. But no evidence shows it can version, review, or roll back those automations. Docs Suggestion Mode applies to Docs, not automations, and the MCP server's local-testing note concerns developer tooling, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
